{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CcryYyjAEhuPooSj7yMbF","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_017GtF4BZDR4ESsH4v97pAKn","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 << 'EOF'\nimport pandas as pd, numpy as np\ndf = pd.read_csv('dataset/synthetic_stroke_data.csv')\ndf['orig_idx'] = df.index\n\n# Step 1: technical noise\nnoise = (df['age']>120) | (df['age']<0) | (df['avg_glucose_level']<20) | (df['avg_glucose_level']>800) | (df['bmi']<10) | (df['bmi']>60)\nprint('noise rows:', noise.sum())\nd = df[~noise].copy()\nprint('remaining:', len(d))\n\n# Step 2: 3*IQR per numeric col\ndef iqr_out(s, k=3):\n    q1, q3 = s.quantile(.25), s.quantile(.75)\n    iqr = q3-q1\n    return (s < q1-k*iqr) | (s > q3+k*iqr)\n\nfor c in ['age','bmi','avg_glucose_level']:\n    m = iqr_out(d[c])\n    print(c, 'outliers:', m.sum())\n\ng_out = iqr_out(d['avg_glucose_level'])\nprint('glucose outliers stroke rate:', d.loc[g_out,'stroke'].mean(), 'n=', g_out.sum())\nprint('non-outlier stroke rate:', d.loc[~g_out,'stroke'].mean())\n\n# log2 check\nlg = np.log2(d['avg_glucose_level'])\ng_out2 = iqr_out(lg)\nprint('log2 glucose outliers:', g_out2.sum(), 'stroke rate:', d.loc[g_out2,'stroke'].mean() if g_out2.sum()>0 else None)\nEOF","description":"Test IQR outlier detection and glucose-stroke rule"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":555,"cache_read_input_tokens":22432,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":555,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"2a9c850f-b585-4744-8e6e-8a144393b480","uuid":"37b10c4b-077c-428d-823b-16cc2e639ed4","request_id":"req_011CcryYy7D2nq9YwRFH7Sk7"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CcrybfbLPoYc4naccU5iZ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_011tCsyJPjduwY2XRh38GZeV","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 << 'EOF'\nimport pandas as pd, numpy as np\nfrom scipy.stats import chi2\ndf = pd.read_csv('dataset/synthetic_stroke_data.csv')\nnoise = (df['age']>120) | (df['age']<0) | (df['avg_glucose_level']<20) | (df['avg_glucose_level']>800) | (df['bmi']<10) | (df['bmi']>60)\nd = df[~noise].copy()\n\n# risk proxy\nnum = ['age','bmi','avg_glucose_level']\nfor c in num:\n    d[c+'_n'] = d[c]/d[c].max()\nd['risk_proxy'] = d['age_n']*d['bmi_n']*d['avg_glucose_level_n']\n\ndef maha_out(X):\n    mu = X.mean(axis=0)\n    cov = np.cov(X, rowvar=False)\n    inv = np.linalg.inv(cov)\n    diff = X - mu\n    d2 = np.einsum('ij,jk,ik->i', diff, inv, diff)\n    crit = chi2.ppf(0.99, X.shape[1])\n    return d2 > crit, crit\n\nX3 = d[num].values\nm3, c3 = maha_out(X3)\nprint('3D (age,bmi,glucose): crit', round(c3,3), 'outliers', m3.sum())\n\nX4 = d[num+['risk_proxy']].values\nm4, c4 = maha_out(X4)\nprint('4D (+risk_proxy): crit', round(c4,3), 'outliers', m4.sum())\n\nX1 = d[['risk_proxy']].values\nm1, c1 = maha_out(X1)\nprint('1D risk_proxy only: crit', round(c1,3), 'outliers', m1.sum())\n\n# categorical checks\nprint()\nprint('work_type children ages:', d.loc[d.work_type=='children','age'].describe()[['min','max','count']].to_dict())\nprint('work_type student ages:', d.loc[d.work_type=='student','age'].describe()[['min','max','count']].to_dict())\nsmoker = d['smoking_status'].isin(['smokes','formerly smoked'])\nprint('child (age<=14) smokers:', ((d.age<=14)&smoker).sum())\nprint('work_type==children & smoker:', ((d.work_type=='children')&smoker).sum())\nprint('work_type==children & smoker & age<=14:', ((d.work_type=='children')&smoker&(d.age<=14)).sum())\nprint('toddler (age<=3) students:', ((d.age<=3)&(d.work_type=='student')).sum())\nprint('toddler & children work:', ((d.age<=3)&(d.work_type=='children')).sum())\nprint('smokers age<=14 work types:', d.loc[(d.age<=14)&smoker,'work_type'].value_counts().to_dict())\nEOF","description":"Test Mahalanobis variants and categorical outlier checks"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3060,"cache_read_input_tokens":22987,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":3060,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"2a9c850f-b585-4744-8e6e-8a144393b480","uuid":"3a493e07-c9d5-464a-9ea2-006939d738c0","request_id":"req_011CcrybdVaT9ej2MBXq3aJv"}

first row of the dataset is indexed as 0; patient_id is the unique key\n    df = df.reset_index(drop=True)\n    id_to_index = dict(zip(df[\"patient_id\"], df.index))\n\n    # Step 1: discard technical noise (physically impossible values)\n    noise = (\n        (df[\"age\"] < 0)\n        | (df[\"age\"] > AGE_MAX)\n        | (df[\"avg_glucose_level\"] < GLUCOSE_RANGE[0])\n        | (df[\"avg_glucose_level\"] > GLUCOSE_RANGE[1])\n        | (df[\"bmi\"] < BMI_RANGE[0])\n        | (df[\"bmi\"] > BMI_RANGE[1])\n    )\n    data = df.loc[~noise].copy()\n\n    #
